core_web_vitals_lab.note: Lab LCP likely understates real perceived load time; see finding intro-loader-blocks-content

findings.title: Full-screen intro curtain (Loader.jsx) blocks all real content for ~2.5-3.7s on every fresh page load, no repeat-visit skip
findings.evidence: Fixed z-index:9999 inset:0 overlay, TOTAL_DUR=2450ms (FALLBACK_MS=4500ms) hardcoded; Header.jsx hero entrance waits on app:intro-ready dispatched by the loader. Trace screenshots confirm curtain still visible at 1396ms (mobile) / 3269ms (desktop, last captured frame); real hero content only appears at 3722ms (mobile). No sessionStorage/localStorage gate for repeat visits.
findings.recommendation: Cut TOTAL_DUR to <400-600ms or remove; add a session-based skip so it plays at most once per visit, not every load. Largest expected lever on real-world LCP/perceived performance.

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts request chain despite existing preload/swap trick
findings.evidence: render-blocking-insight: est. savings 1850ms mobile / 280ms desktop. 3-hop network dependency chain (HTML -> fonts.googleapis.com/css2 -> fonts.gstatic.com woff2), longest chain 961ms.
findings.recommendation: Self-host critical Inter/Playfair Display weights as woff2 with <link rel=preload as=font crossorigin>, keep font-display:swap, drop Google Fonts origin round-trip.

findings.title: david_transparent.png is 1.43MB, 74% of total 1.94MB page weight
findings.evidence: total-byte-weight audit: david_transparent.png = 1,431,179 bytes, used as WebGL diffuse texture in HeroPortrait.jsx
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP (alpha-capable) and cap resolution to canvas's actual max display size at DPR<=2; expect 300-900KB savings.

findings.title: 4 work-row thumbnails deliver full 1280x960 source despite srcset with 640w/960w candidates
findings.evidence: image-delivery-insight (mobile): est. savings 230KB across work-outreach-v2.webp, work-research-v2.webp, work-crm-v3.webp, work-ads-v2.webp, each displayed at 362x271 CSS px.
findings.recommendation: Tighten sizes attribute to the true max rendered width instead of a vw estimate; verify 640w/960w variants are actually selected across common DPRs.

findings.title: 46% (48.5KB) of the main JS bundle unused on initial load
findings.evidence: unused-javascript audit on assets/index-BE7mlwOu.js: totalBytes 105175, wastedBytes 48551 (46.16%)
findings.recommendation: Code-split WebGL hero portrait and below-the-fold component logic (FAQ, Services, marquee) via React.lazy()/dynamic import.

findings.title: Desktop CLS 0.013 from hero name reflow on web font swap (already passing)
findings.evidence: cls-culprits-insight (desktop): hero__word span shift score 0.0126 + 0.0006, cause: Web font (Playfair Display, Inter)
findings.recommendation: Resolved as a side effect of self-hosting fonts with preload (see render-blocking-google-fonts).

what_works: TTFB excellent: 56ms mobile / 53ms desktop, hosting/edge is not a bottleneck
TBT 0ms both mobile and desktop, no long main-thread tasks (INP proxy currently good)
DOM size small and healthy: 236 elements, max depth 12
No duplicated or legacy JavaScript (0 wasted bytes on both audits)
No render-blocking third-party scripts beyond Google Fonts, and that has 0ms main-thread cost
Responsive image srcset infrastructure already exists for work thumbnails (needs sizes tuning, not a rebuild)
